data.name: Frontline: Operation Kosmonaut
data.detailed_description:
The Cold War was not fought in public.

1987. Northern Soviet Territory.

A classified orbital defense facility has fallen under the control of rogue officers within the Soviet military.

The mission is internal. The operation is deniable. Failure is not an option.

You are part of a Spetsnaz unit deployed to reclaim the installation, eliminate traitors, and secure the Kosmonaut satellite program before it destabilizes the balance of power.

There will be no headlines. There will be no recognition.

Only orders.

A grounded Cold War military FPS

FRONTLINE: OPERATION KOSMONAUT is a focused, story-driven first-person shooter inspired by late 90s / early 2000s military titles.

No modern gimmicks. No open-world distractions. No regenerative health.

Just tactical combat in hostile conditions.

Key Features

• Realistic 1987 setting based on Cold War military atmosphere • Play as a Soviet Spetsnaz operative • Linear, tightly designed campaign • No regenerating health – use medkits and manage resources • Tactical enemy AI and intense close-quarters combat • Snowstorms, radar complexes, underground bunkers, rocket hangars • Minimal HUD and grounded military presentation • Retro-inspired design with modern technical stability

Brutal Conditions. Limited Information.

Fight through:

Frozen perimeter defenses

Concrete Soviet bunkers

Underground transit tunnels

A live rocket assembly hangar

A countdown control center under red emergency lighting

Every engagement matters. Every mistake costs.

Built in the Spirit of Classic Military Shooters

FRONTLINE focuses on atmosphere, tension, and disciplined combat pacing.

If you miss the era when shooters were cold, direct, and unapologetically linear — this is your deployment.
